targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(start_date, logical_date) AS "time", dag_id AS metric, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(end_date, now()) - start_date)) AS value FROM dag_run WHERE start_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(COALESCE(start_date, logical_date)) ORDER BY 1;

SELECT dag_id AS "DAG", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(end_date, now()) - start_date)))::numeric, 2) AS "Avg runtime (s)", MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(end_date, now()) - start_date))) AS "Max runtime (s)", COUNT(*) AS "Runs" FROM dag_run WHERE start_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(COALESCE(start_date, logical_date)) GROUP BY dag_id ORDER BY 2 DESC;
